claim: AI and agents influenced 20% of global online holiday sales in 2025, about US$262 billion.
source: Salesforce, Salesforce Reveals 2025 Holiday Shopping Data

claim: Shoppers referred to retail sites from AI-powered search channels converted nine times more often than shoppers referred from social media.
source: Salesforce, Salesforce Reveals 2025 Holiday Shopping Data

claim: Traffic to US retail sites from generative AI tools rose 693.4% year on year in the 2025 holiday season.
source: Adobe, Holiday Shopping Season Drove a Record $257.8 Billion Online

claim: Customer support agents using a generative AI assistant resolved 13.8% more issues per hour, with no significant change in customer satisfaction.
source: NBER, Measuring the Productivity Impact of Generative AI

claim: AI-driven forecasting can reduce supply chain forecast errors by 20-50% and lost sales from product unavailability by up to 65%.
source: McKinsey & Company, AI-driven operations forecasting in data-light environments

claim: AI can reduce distributors' inventory levels by 20-30% through better demand forecasting.
source: McKinsey & Company, Harnessing the power of AI in distribution operations

claim: Retailers deploying AI and machine learning achieved sales growth 2.3 times higher and profit growth 2.5 times higher than competitors.
source: IHL Group, Retail Inventory Crisis Persists Despite $172 Billion in Improvements

claim: Well-adopted dynamic pricing typically delivers sales growth of 2-5% and margin increases of 5-10% for retailers.
source: McKinsey & Company, How retailers can drive profitable growth through dynamic pricing

claim: Service reps using AI spend 20% less time on routine cases, freeing about four hours a week.
source: Salesforce, AI Expected to Resolve Half of Service Cases by 2027 (State of Service)

claim: About 12% of Australian businesses used AI in 2024-25, up from about 1% in the previous survey.
source: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Business adoption of Artificial Intelligence accelerates in 2024-25
